data.name: Mathivanan
data.gender_notes: Mathivanan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Mathivanan is a Tamil name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Mathees', which means 'wisdom'. It is a name that signifies intelligence, knowledge, and understanding. Mathivanan is often considered a divine name, representing the god of wisdom and learning. The name Mathivanan carries the meaning “God of Wisdom” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Tamil. Parents who choose Mathivanan usually hope their child will grow to embody god of wisdom and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Mathivanan is a name that is deeply connected to spirituality and wisdom. It is believed to bring the blessings of the gods of knowledge and wisdom, and is often given to children who are expected to grow up to be wise and knowledgeable individuals.
data.etymology: Mathivanan belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Wisdom.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mathivanan total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
